title: Garlic Tomato Pasta
ingredients: pasta, tomato, garlic, olive oil, salt
instructions: Boil pasta. Sauté garlic and tomatoes in olive oil. Mix and serve.

title: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs, add cheese, salt, and pepper. Cook in buttered pan.

title: Spicy Fried Rice
ingredients: rice, soy sauce, chili sauce, egg, spring onion
instructions: Cook rice. Stir-fry with sauces, egg, and spring onion.

title: Classic Grilled Cheese
instructions: Butter the bread. Add cheese and grill until golden.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook chopped tomato and onion with garlic. Blend and serve hot.
